context: Work on the still-monolithic run.sh; the big lib extraction is Phase 2. GUARDRAILS: package-registry domains (npm, pypi, github) are opt-in via --allow-packages, never default - defaulting them silently widens the boundary; exactly one trap EXIT registration point after the fix; egress image built and pinned locally, no third-party digest dependency. Anti-patterns: no allowlist wildcards; no git add -A; do not touch Gradle machinery.
description: Replace single-purpose egress-proxy with a locally built egress image (Containerfile.egress: alpine + socat + tinyproxy). Port 8080 = socat raw forward to inference server (pi path, byte-identical). Port 8888 = tinyproxy, FilterDefaultDeny, rendered allowlist from Spike B seeds. Egress container named egress-<shorthash(config)> so config changes (allowlist, inference target) start a fresh container - fixes the silent-stale-target reuse in upstream ensure_egress_proxy (run.sh:279). Health = listener probe plus end-to-end request through the proxy (warn-only). Pass EGRESS_PROXY_IP and EGRESS_PROXY_HTTP_PORT into ALL run modes (today only --shell gets it, run.sh:574). Also: fix the EXIT-trap overwrite bug (run.sh:467 vs :552 - openrouter runs leak RENDERED_CONFIG_DIR) via a composed add_cleanup in lib/common.sh, and add x11-utils so the Xvfb readiness loop stops being a no-op.
